exact_statement: For every N>=1 the minimum positive physical influence of a uniform-cube Boolean sign is N*2^(1-N). At equality the signs are exactly point defects and complements for N>=3, the two nonconstant one-bit signs for N=1, and the eight point/complement signs plus four signed dictators for N=2. For every fixed ell>=2, at cutoff s_*(N)=N-1-log2 N the all-dimensional suprema of R_geell/I and M_geell/I are exactly 2 and 1, strictly approached but unattained at finite N. Here R uses phi(x,y)=(x+y)h2(y/(x+y)) and M uses y log2((x+y)/y) on edges whose lower endpoint has size at least ell. The unrestricted constants exceed 107/40 and 47/40 respectively, witnessed by the five-bit sign negative exactly on {5,12,13}. Thus loss-free optimal-tail completeness cannot extend from sublinear cutoffs to arbitrary finite nonnegative cutoffs. A090@1 and A096@1 retain their explicitly stated sublinear scope; no full FEI conclusion is asserted.
